items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Well, the first one was a real band. It was Freddie Keppert. He was a great trumpet player. ... Yes, I heard Freddie Keppert around 14.

ctx.x: Can you tell the first New Orleans band you ever heard? Who were the first musicians from New Orleans aside from Tony Jackson that you heard?

Well, the first one was a real band. It was Freddie Keppert. He was a great trumpet player. And a few years later the band broke up, which they all would form and then break up short. Oh, sure. When they got out of whack.
Do you remember about when you first heard Freddie Keppert? What year? Could you remember?
